name: PLATO Convex Continuous QPLIB Benchmark
description: Evaluates continuous convex QP solvers on 42 CPU instances and additional GPU instances drawn from QPLIB, covering both interior-point and first-order GPU-accelerated methods. The benchmark compares classical solvers (MOSEK, KNITRO, IPOPT, COPT) against GPU implementations (cuOpt, HPR-QP) at varying solution tolerances (1e-4, 1e-6, 1e-8). Convex continuous QPs have unique globally optimal solutions.
typical_sota_score: COPT (1.0s, 42/42 CPU); KNITRO (1.95x); MOSEK (2.38x). GPU: cuOpt strong at standard tolerances; HPR-QP competitive at varying precision. 2-hour CPU limit.
reputation: Current benchmark comparing CPU and GPU QP solvers; maintained by Hans Mittelmann at ASU.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. GPU hardware: NVIDIA B200 (192GB). Problems from QPLIB IDs 2456–10038. Tests both CPU and GPU solver performance at multiple accuracy tolerances.
